title: Risk prediction of covid-19 related death and hospital admission in adults after covid-19 vaccination: national prospective cohort study.

majorUnsupportedClaims: The generated text fabricated proportions for the top 5% highest risk group: dementia 24.4% (source: 12.86%), coronary heart disease 39.1% (source: 26.05%), heart failure 26.5% (source: 11.53%), stroke 30.2% (source: 16.09%), atrial fibrillation 31.5% (source: 20.82%). None of these numbers appear in the reference.
model.rationale: While most of the generated text faithfully reproduces study design, population, and methods, the results section contains severely fabricated statistics for the characteristics of the top 5% risk group (e.g., dementia, coronary heart disease percentages). These invented numbers are not supported by the reference and constitute a major factual error, making the output unreliable.
